descriptions.value: The Okta Hyperdrive Integration installer does not mask the OAuth client secret when passed as an MSI property. The credential is recorded in plaintext in the installer log, the Application Event Log, and the process command line, all of which are readable by an authenticated local user on the workstation.

descriptions.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
